exposure: Doppler changes in fetal arterial system (middle cerebral artery, umbilical artery, thoracic aorta)
cohort: The study included 50 fetuses with an estimated birth weight less than the 10th percentile beyond 24 weeks of gestation, suspected of intrauterine growth retardation.
finding: Abnormal Doppler parameters, particularly an abnormal cerebroplacental ratio, are significantly associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes in fetuses with intrauterine growth retardation.
mod_finding: An abnormal thoracic aorta pulsatility index and cerebroplacental ratio were associated with the highest chance of cesarean section for fetal distress.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight less than 10th percentile
